descriptions.job-0yzkjvg:
About the Company

Rain makes the next generation of payments possible across the globe. We’re a lean and mighty team of passionate builders and veteran founders. Our infrastructure makes stablecoins usable in the real-world by powering card transactions, cross-border payments, B2B purchases, remittances, and more. We partner with fintechs, neobanks, and institutions to help them launch solutions that are global, inclusive, and efficient. You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company that is funded by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS, including ICONIQ, Sapphire Ventures, Norwest, Galaxy Ventures, Lightspeed, Khosla, and several more. If you’re curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we’d love to talk.

Our Ethos

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

About the Role

Rain is hiring a Financial Partnerships Manager to expand our strategic financial ecosystem partnerships globally.

This role is responsible for identifying, developing, and managing the partnerships that enable Rain’s products, expansion, and long-term growth. These relationships may include banks, financial institutions, payment processors, fiat on/off-ramp providers, treasury and liquidity providers, compliance infrastructure providers, fintech platforms, and other strategic financial ecosystem participants.

You will own the strategy and execution behind some of Rain’s most important external relationships. This includes sourcing and evaluating new partnership opportunities, negotiating commercial and operational agreements, driving cross-functional initiatives, and ensuring partners are positioned to support Rain’s evolving business objectives.

You will serve as a bridge between external partners and internal stakeholders across Product, Compliance, Legal, Operations, GTM, Risk, and Executive Leadership. Success in this role requires exceptional organization, strong relationship management, sound commercial judgment, and a deep understanding of how modern financial infrastructure is built and operated.

As Financial Partnerships Manager, you will help shape Rain’s infrastructure strategy by identifying new capabilities, unlocking market expansion opportunities, improving economics, reducing operational dependencies, and strengthening the resilience of our partner ecosystem.

This is a highly cross-functional role that requires equal comfort operating at both strategic and execution levels while managing complex initiatives across a rapidly evolving financial landscape.

The Impact You Will Have

  • Execute Rain’s financial partnership strategy to support product expansion, geographic growth, and infrastructure resilience

  • Build and deepen relationships across financial institutions, fintech infrastructure providers, and strategic ecosystem partners

  • Identify, evaluate, and secure new partnerships that unlock product capabilities, regulatory coverage, market access, improved economics, or operational efficiencies

  • Lead complex cross-functional initiatives with partners from initial evaluation through implementation, launch, and ongoing optimization

  • Serve as the internal owner and quarterback for launching Rain’s strategic partner relationships

  • Identify partnership risks, operational bottlenecks, and ecosystem dependencies while driving mitigation plans and contingency strategies

  • Help shape product and expansion strategies by bringing market intelligence, partner feedback, and ecosystem insights into internal planning processes

  • Position Rain as a preferred long-term partner within the global financial infrastructure ecosystem

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, financial services, fintech, payments, banking, crypto, or financial infrastructure

  • Deep familiarity with modern financial ecosystems, including banking, payments, stablecoins, treasury operations, settlement infrastructure, compliance systems, and money movement

  • Demonstrated success building and managing strategic partnerships with financial institutions, infrastructure providers, fintechs, or technology platforms

  • Experience negotiating and managing complex commercial relationships involving legal, compliance, operational, technical, and executive stakeholders

  • Strong understanding of stablecoins, cross-border payments, financial infrastructure, and the evolving intersection of traditional finance and digital assets

  • Experience leading large cross-functional initiatives that require alignment across multiple internal and external stakeholders

  • Experience operating within regulated environments and working closely with compliance, legal, and risk teams

  • Ability to evaluate partnership opportunities through strategic, commercial, operational, and regulatory lenses

  • Strong project management and organizational skills with a proven ability to drive initiatives from concept through execution

  • Demonstrated ability to identify process improvements, build scalable solutions, and thrive in fast-moving, iterative environments.

  • Clear, disciplined communicator capable of translating complex technical and regulatory concepts into actionable business decisions.

    Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:

Unlimited time off 🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

Flexible working ☕ We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace.

Easy to access benefits 🧠 For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company-subsidized life insurance plan.

Retirement goals💡 Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

Equity plan 📦 Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success.

Health and Wellness 📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

In-office meals 🍜 Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit.

Team summits ✨ Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international.
descriptions.job-1ljxavw:
Institutional Fabric for the Digital Asset Market

Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. Whether in-office or remote, you’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.

Sales Associate

This is an early-career sales opportunity for individuals looking to build a long-term career at the intersection of institutional finance and digital assets.

As a Sales Associate at Talos, you will work closely with senior Sales and Solutions colleagues across the full deal lifecycle - from initial outreach and qualification through to solutioning, trials, and close. You will develop strong product expertise, gain a deep understanding of institutional trading workflows, and contribute directly to pipeline generation and deal execution.

Talos operates a structured, consultative sales environment. This role is well-suited to someone who is organized, intellectually curious, and motivated to understand how markets and trading infrastructure function.

Responsibilities

  • Support pipeline generation through targeted prospecting, outreach, and early-stage qualification across Talos’s core client segments, including hedge funds, market makers, prime brokers, and digital asset service providers.

  • Participate in discovery and demo calls alongside senior sales team members, learning to map client workflows and requirements to Talos’s product capabilities.

  • Maintain high-quality CRM hygiene in Salesforce, ensuring all opportunities, contacts, and activities are accurately recorded and up to date.

  • Conduct market and account research to identify high-potential prospects and inform account prioritization strategies.

  • Coordinate cross-functionally with Solutions, Account Management, Product, and Engineering to advance deals and ensure accurate client communication.

  • Support proposal development, workflow documentation, and follow-up materials for active opportunities.

  • Capture and quantify product feedback and feature requests, connecting client insights to product roadmap discussions.

  • Build strong product knowledge over time, including Talos’s capabilities, competitive positioning, and technical architecture.

  • Represent Talos at industry conferences and client events to build relationships, enhance brand presence, and identify new business opportunities.

Requirements

  • 1 - 2 years of experience in a client-facing role, ideally within enterprise SaaS, fintech, or institutional financial services.

  • Strong recent graduates with relevant internship experience will also be considered.

  • Demonstrated interest in financial markets, trading, and technology.

  • Familiarity with digital assets or crypto markets is advantageous but not required.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple workflows reliably.

  • Experience using CRM systems (preferably Salesforce) within a structured sales process.

  • Clear and professional communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts in straightforward terms.

  • Coachable, proactive, and thoughtful in approach, with good judgment on when to escalate versus act independently.

  • High level of ownership and self-direction; able to identify priorities, remove blockers, and maintain momentum without constant guidance.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed team environment with a high degree of autonomy.

Our Sales Approach

Talos operates a systematic, consultative sales process built around a simple principle: listen first, sell second. We take the time to understand a client's workflows, constraints, and goals before positioning a solution. We sell what we have - with deep product mastery and honest conversations about what's on the roadmap and what isn't.

We maintain a balanced pipeline across focus segments, use Salesforce rigorously to track progress, and hand off every closed deal with a documented account plan so the relationship starts on solid footing from day one.

We play the long game. Underpromise, overdeliver, and build the kind of relationships that compound over time.

Check out these videos and links to learn more about Talos and our culture!

  • Spotlight Article: Talos Snapshot by DRW

  • Podcast: 2023 episode with co-founders Anton & Ethan

  • Website: Explore Talos: Products, Investors, Team & More

  • Case Studies: Real world examples of client solutions

  • Awards: Talos Wins Hedgeweek Global Digital Assets Award 2024

  • Culture: Award-winning, Forbes-listed, low-attrition team

Andreessen Horowitz re: Talos: "The company best suited to drive institutional adoption is one that understands traditional capital markets deeply and is forward-thinking enough to fully grasp the promise of crypto. Talos is that company."

Benefits

You will also enjoy a comprehensive array of competitive benefits, regardless of your location, within our warm, welcoming, and ambitious company culture. Some of our benefits include:

  • Retirement plan contributions

  • Unlimited Vacation + a PTO bonus: Employees that take 15 days of vacation, with 5 days being consecutive, receive a $2000 USD bonus.

  • Bonus and stock ownership

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Paid parental leave for 20 weeks, after 1 year of service

  • Global offsites and team outings

  • A one-time stipend towards at-home office set-up for all employees

  • A wellness credit of $50 accrued monthly, to go towards things like gym memberships, ski-passes, and work out classes.

  • A lunch credit of $25 USD towards lunches for days in-office

  • Donation matching up to $100 USD annually

  • Other in-office perks: Catered lunches on Tuesdays, snacks, and drinks

Check out other open positions listed on our website!

Talos is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer.  We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.  Talos is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process.  If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at careers@talos.com.

descriptions.job-1hy5a70:
About the Role

We are hiring our next Sales Development Representative to build and qualify pipeline for our sales team. You will own two streams of work: qualifying inbound interest from prospective partners, and running targeted outbound to the banks, fintechs, brokerages, and payment companies that make up our ideal customer profile. You will be the first substantive touchpoint many prospects have with zerohash, so you will set the tone for a responsive, credible, and professional partnership.

This is a foundational hire on a growing team, with a clear path toward Account Executive and other roles in the sales organization for reps who perform.

Responsibilities

Inbound qualification

  • Respond quickly to inbound interest from our website, partnerships, integrations, and marketing programs.
  • Run structured discovery calls and qualify prospects against our ideal customer profile — factors such as regulatory posture, platform scale, and existing crypto or fiat offerings.
  • Produce clean handoffs to Account Executives, capturing pain points, timeline, decision-makers, and fit.

Outbound prospecting

  • Run targeted outbound campaigns to a defined set of strategic accounts across banking, fintech, brokerage, and payments.
  • Build multi-threaded relationships across several stakeholders per account, including crypto, compliance, and finance leaders.
  • Use warm paths — mutual connections, industry events, and partner referrals — alongside cold outreach.
  • Surface early-stage pain points and fit, and book qualified meetings for Account Executives.

Craft and collaboration

  • Keep Salesforce and outreach tooling accurate and up to date.
  • Partner closely with Account Executives and marketing to refine targeting, messaging, and qualification criteria over time.
  • Build institutional knowledge on our target accounts — decision-makers, priorities, and buying triggers.

Requirements

  • 2–3 years of B2B SaaS or fintech sales development experience.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce and modern outbound tooling (e.g. LinkedIn Sales Navigator, email sequencing platforms such as Outreach or Salesloft).
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with comfort handling objections.
  • Ability to qualify prospects against a defined ideal customer profile.
  • Coachability and a willingness to refine your approach based on feedback and data.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with crypto, blockchain, or digital assets.
  • Background in regulated financial services.
  • Experience selling into compliance-heavy buying cycles.

What success looks like

In your first year you will establish a fast, professional inbound qualification process, build systematic outbound coverage of our strategic accounts, and generate a healthy, well-qualified pipeline for the sales team. You will become a trusted partner to our Account Executives and a credible first point of contact for prospective partners.

Benefits

  • Healthcare Insurance: zerohash covers roughly 100% of employee premiums as well as a portion of spouse/children (U.S. only)
  • Vision & Dental Insurance (U.S. only)
  • Chance to earn equity
  • Maternity & Paternity leave (after 6 months)
  • WeWork All Access Membership
  • WFH Yearly Stipend
  • L&D Yearly Stipend (after 6 months)

About zerohash

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.

The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. Through a single integration, customers can launch regulated crypto buy, sell, and custody services; enable 24/7 stablecoin-based funding, payouts, and settlement; and issue and manage tokenized assets with built-in compliance, risk controls, and reporting. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global.
zerohash is trusted by some of the world’s most recognized financial and consumer brands, including Interactive Brokers, Morgan Stanley, Stripe, Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, DraftKings, Gusto, Worldpay, Kalshi, One Pay, among others. Today, zero infrastructure supports millions of end users across brokerage, wealth, payments, and marketplace platforms globally.

The company is deeply regulated and compliance-first, operating across the U.S. and internationally with licenses and approvals that allow partners to enter crypto and stablecoins with confidence. zerohash has become a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to modernize financial products while meeting the highest standards for security, risk management, and regulatory oversight.

To date, zerohash has raised over $280 million in funding from a mix of leading venture firms and strategic investors, including Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Point72 Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and more.
zerohash has been featured in top-tier media outlets such as Bloomberg, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Forbes, and CoinDesk, and its leadership team regularly contributes to global conversations on the future of payments, investing, and financial infrastructure.

At zerohash, we're building the infrastructure that makes digital money work securely, compliantly, and at global scale.

The zerohash Culture

All zerohash employees are guided by the following characteristics and core principles:

  • Independence/Ownership - An ability to work autonomously. Join zerohash, pitch ideas, and shape the work you do.
  • Passion - We are innovating quickly and challenging the status quo. We want you to think big, be creative and ​make a difference every day.
  • Collaborative - A good attitude and respect for others. We’re teammates, not co-workers. Everything we do is a shared success and equally a shared failure - we talk in terms of “we” not “me”.
  • Initiative - An ability and passion for learning and asking questions. We will champion you, challenge you and push you to achieve your best - and we expect you to do the same.
  • Empathy - An ability to listen, respect, and understand your co-workers, customers, and everyone you interact with no matter how different they are to you.
  • Adaptability - An ability to respond quickly. We are in a fast-paced industry and so we expect you to be creative when solving a new problem and comfortable under pressure.
  • Transparency - We believe that transparency is critical to empowering everyone to make the best decisions, both the company to its people and vice versa.
  • Integrity - Integrity creates trust. As both an organization collectively and as individuals, it is our most valuable asset.

Follow us

Twitter

LinkedIn

Youtube

For candidates based in Colorado, please contact colorado-wages @zerohash.com to request compensation and benefits information regarding a particular role(s). Please include with your email the city you reside (or intend to reside in Colorado) and the title/link to the roles you're interested in.

**We’ve recently seen an increase in individuals impersonating zerohash recruiters to target job seekers. Please stay vigilant and keep the following in mind to ensure you are communicating with the real zerohash team:

  • Verified Emails Only: Official outreach will only come from a @zerohash.com email address.
  • No Messaging Apps: We will never contact you via unsolicited text messages, WhatsApp, or Telegram.
  • Official Applications: Only apply directly through our careers webpage (zerohash.com/careers) or zero-hash.breezy.hr.

See something suspicious?
If you want to verify an interview request or report a fake job posting or suspicious communication, please contact us immediately at talent @zerohash.com. This email is for fraud reports only. Candidate application inquiries will not be responded to.
descriptions.job-0k2wkrg:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to own paid acquisition on YouTube, ChatGPT, X, Rideshare, and Reddit, and to find new incremental channels. You'll take early experiments and turn them into measurable programs and build the operating model that makes successful channels part of Ramp's evergreen performance marketing mix.

This is a high-autonomy role. You will evaluate channel opportunities, design tests, launch campaigns, and analyze full-funnel performance. You'll work with Growth, Creative, Data, Finance, and other cross-functional partners to move quickly while maintaining a high bar for measurement & efficiency.

You’ll use AI as a practical part of the job: building systems that speed up research, campaign creation, performance analysis, and day-to-day channel operations.

What You'll Do

  • Own performance on YouTube, ChatGPT, X, Rideshare, and Reddit. Understand how conversion events, value signals, and lookalike audiences work at a technical level and use that to make channels more efficient over time.

  • Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new performance marketing channels and acquisition opportunities.

  • Build the path from experiment to evergreen program: prove incremental SQLs and pipeline impact, hit LTV-to-CAC efficiency targets, and document a repeatable operating playbook.

  • Own channels as they mature. Decide when a program stays with you and when it transitions to a dedicated owner so you can keep finding new ones.

  • Analyze performance across the full funnel. Turn incomplete or noisy data into a clear call on what to scale, improve, pause, or stop.

  • Partner with data and engineering to improve tracking, attribution, and reporting, and with Creative on messaging, format, and ad concepts across surfaces, audiences, and channels.

  • Build AI agents, workflows, and tools that help the team test more ideas and operationalize channels faster.

What You Need

  • 3+ years in a performance / quantitative marketing, growth, or comparable decision-science role, where you’ve owned numbers and shaped meaningful outcomes.

  • Strong analytical judgment. You can define success metrics, diagnose and isolate performance issues, and make decisions with imperfect information.

  • You enjoy designing experiments and translating results into a clear call on what to fund, scale, or kill.

  • You've built AI workflows, automations, or agents to improve marketing execution and you have good judgment about where AI accelerates the work and where human review is necessary.

  • You move projects from ambiguity to a clear outcome with limited direction and you're detail-oriented in campaign setup, tracking, and measurement.

Nice-to-Haves

  • B2B experience.

  • Experience bringing an experimental channel into a scaled program.

  • Familiarity with attribution, incrementality testing, randomized controlled tests (RCTs), MMM, and marketing measurement.

Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Centralized home-office equipment ordering

  • Health and wellness stipend

  • Budget for intra-office travel

  • Weekly coffee stipend

United States

  • 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

  • One Medical annual membership

  • 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

  • Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

  • Pet insurance

  • In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

  • Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

Canada

  • Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

  • Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

  • Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

  • Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

  • Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

United Kingdom

  • Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

  • Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

  • Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

  • Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

Referral Instructions

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

 

Other notices

descriptions.job-1mbud98:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe is building the economic engine for AI – and it’s working. Today, 88% of the Forbes AI 50 are building on Stripe (and most of the remaining 12% are pre-monetization).

The AI GTM team is focused on helping AI-native businesses monetize and scale. We're in a unique position—partnering with the world's most ambitious AI companies (like OpenAI, Anthropic, ElevenLabs, and NVIDIA) to help them grow. This is one of the fastest growing parts of the business, and we need more great people to help us continue to accelerate.

What you'll do

As a Sales Manager on the AI GTM team at Stripe, you will leverage your sales leadership and product expertise to drive growth through new and existing strategic AI customers. Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer of AI, you will lead a team of Account Executives responsible for expanding Stripe's relationship with some of the most important AI companies in the world—across payments, billing, and beyond.

You will be instrumental in leading in-depth product discussions with customers, developing consultative and solution-based sales strategies, and building deep knowledge of the AI industry and its unique monetization challenges. You will collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, Product Marketing, and User Operations teams to develop and execute against our go-to-market strategy.

Responsibilities

  • Develop the long-term vision for a growing AI GTM team and scale day-to-day operations. 
  • Lead and manage a team of Account Executives managing existing AI accounts (driving revenue expansion, product attach, and retention) and looking for new business opportunities. Establish strategic plans and objectives to drive growth across the AI GTM business line, guiding execution to KPIs.
  • Build and develop a high-performing team, fostering a strong culture of energized and engaged Stripes while investing in the growth and development of your team. Coach and guide the team in developing consultative and solution-based sales skills throughout the sales cycle.
  • Be accountable for driving revenue, increasing product attach rates, and growing existing clients at high rates.
  • Engage with Product, Marketing, and User Operations teams to influence our product roadmap (you are on the frontier!) and accelerate our growth trajectory for our AI industry users.
  • Serve as both an internal and customer-facing expert on Stripe's products, particularly as they apply to AI-native business models (usage-based billing, marketplace payments, embedded finance, agentic commerce).
  • Build strong relationships with customer executives (CEO, CFO, CTO) and serve as a trusted advisor on how Stripe can support their growth.
  • Create best practices and improve the business and customer engagement model.

Who you are

Sales leader. You are an adept sales leader, capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization. You see value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require both deep product understanding and technical knowledge, especially for AI industry users.

People developer. You are a strong people leader who builds high-performing teams through coaching, accountability, and culture. You're as comfortable working with clients as with internal stakeholders (including executives) and are excited to become an expert and share your knowledge. You possess an organized, self-starter mindset and excellent communication skills, with a track record for improving the processes and organizations around you.

AI enthusiast. You have deep context in the AI industry and are energized by keeping up with new developments in the space. You bring a user-first mindset— you approach every customer interaction as a consultative partner rather than a transactional seller.

Technically curious. You understand APIs, webhooks, and modern developer tools—and you can hold credible conversations with engineering leaders about how Stripe's infrastructure fits into their stack.

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of sales leadership experience, launching and growing high-functioning sales teams/products.
  • 10+ years of experience in hyper-growth SaaS or technology environments across the AMER region.
  • Demonstrated success managing existing/growth customer portfolios and driving revenue expansion.
  • Proven ability to be a self-starter, capable of driving business results without significant supervision.
  • Ability to understand complex technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple stakeholders.
  • Deep understanding of AI industry dynamics, business models, and monetization strategies (usage-based pricing, API-first distribution, agentic commerce).
  • Strong product acumen—ability to learn and articulate complex product capabilities, understand how they work technically, and connect them to user needs.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including strong presentation skills for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders.
  • An enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality.
  • Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke agreements with commercial and enterprise businesses.

Preferred qualifications

  • Industry experience in payments, financial infrastructure, developer tools, or AI/ML platforms.
  • Existing relationships within the AI ecosystem (AI labs, AI-native SaaS companies, developer platforms).
  • Experience selling complex platform solutions involving multiple products.
  • Prior experience at a growth-stage software company or a leading payments/fintech company.
  • Familiarity with Stripe's product suite and how AI companies leverage financial infrastructure to scale.
descriptions.job-14nhb18:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

Our web developers work across our different product areas — Activation, Brokerage, Crypto, and Core Experience — building the rich client-side web application that powers the next generation of Robinhood, creating marketing websites, and developing the infrastructure that enables all web developers to work efficiently on the platform.

As a Software Developer Intern, Web, you'll own meaningful work end-to-end — from initial scoping through production. You'll be embedded on a real team, partnering directly with experienced developers to architect features, build developer tools, and ship software that millions of people use every day. descriptions.job-0whsmzg:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

We are seeking a dedicated and ambitious Product Operations Analyst to join our dynamic team in Singapore. This is an outstanding opportunity to be part of an exceptionally innovative company that is transforming how value moves across borders for financial institutions worldwide. You will play a key role in supporting the growth and scaling of Ripple's diverse product offerings. You will work closely with important internal teams such as Markets, Risk, Treasury, and Legal to provide seamless support for Ripple's 24x7 operations. Your responsibilities will include managing all operational support activities, including reconciliation, trade support, exception processing, and funding and settlement. You will also contribute significantly to developing and managing processes, system configurations, and settlement instructions, ensuring full alignment with our risk management framework, policies, and procedures.

Your Growth Path:
You'll begin with reconciliation and settlement support, then expand into process automation, system configuration, and cross-product expertise as you demonstrate impact. You'll receive structured onboarding and ongoing coaching to build deep expertise in crypto operations, risk management, and process design.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Collaborate with Finance and Operations teams, as well as external customers, to ensure timely settlement of crypto and fiat funds.
  • Reconcile positions and balances for various business operations, including company-issued stablecoin.
  • Monitor intraday trading and settlement activity in close partnership with the Ripple Trading and Markets team.
  • Understand risks and requirements for different asset types, including cryptocurrencies, to ensure quick responses to market activity and exceptions.
  • Record transactions in systems to maintain accurate bookkeeping entries reflecting product and operational activities within Ripple's systems of record.
  • Become an expert in finance operational flows by working with key collaborators to detail existing processes.
  • Identify manual processes that can be automated or streamlined, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING: 

  • Willingness to work a weekend/holiday shift pattern as required. Our team operates during agreed business hours in shifts aligned to your region across a global follow-the-sun model.
  • Relevant hands-on experience in operations, clearing, and settlement, including reconciliation.
  • Proven experience in monitoring venues and systems in real-time to uncover and resolve exceptions, breaks, and blocking issues.
  • Understanding of accounting principles (debits/credits, balance sheet reconciliation) is strongly preferred.
  • Curiosity and initiative to identify manual processes that can be automated or streamlined.
  • High attention to detail with the ability to problem-solve and remain organized in a dynamic environment.
  • Dedicated with a passion for efficiency and continuous improvement.
  • Experience with implementing off-the-shelf and in-house solutions.
  • Broad understanding of markets and instruments (cleared, OTC, crypto, derivatives).

descriptions.job-1tlx42k:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Product Sales is a team of functional and technical specialists who both lead and advise on deals for the most strategically important products in the Stripe portfolio. Revenue suite Product Sales is tasked with pursuing a $100B market opportunity for back-office finance automation across billing, tax, revenue reporting, and data.

What you’ll do

As a Tax Account Executive at Stripe, you'll use your sales and product expertise to help drive growth through both existing and new-to-Stripe customers. You'll collaborate with the core sales, marketing, product marketing, and product teams to develop deep product and industry knowledge and drive strategic deals. You'll lead in-depth product discussions with existing and prospective customers and build and execute against our go-to-market strategy.

Responsibilities

  • Drive revenue and retain users to achieve and over perform on target and KPIs
  • Lead discussions with our largest existing and prospective customers
  • Contribute to the development of go-to-market playbooks alongside product, marketing, sales, and technical services stakeholders
  • Understand and articulate the value propositions of Stripe Tax to key stakeholders, including technical teams, financial departments, partners and C-suite executives.
  • Develop a deep understanding of global indirect tax requirements of potential customers.
  • Build and maintain relationships with clients, guiding them through the sales process and helping ensure a successful implementation of Stripe Tax.
  • Collaborate closely with the product, engineering, marketing, and customer success teams to ensure client satisfaction and long-term growth.
  • Stay up-to-date on industry trends in data, analytics, and reporting to identify new opportunities and keep Stripe ahead of the curve.
  • Identify and pursue expansion opportunities with existing Stripe Tax users to drive adoption of additional compliance tools.
  • Lead renewal conversations with existing Stripe Tax users, leveraging a deep understanding of their evolving business needs.
  • Ensure users are able to quickly go live by proactively addressing any outstanding questions from the sales process.

Who you are

You are an adept salesperson, capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization, including C-Level roles. You are used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require deep product understanding, combined with technical knowledge. You’re comfortable working with clients as you are with internal stakeholders (including executives). You’re excited to become an expert and to share your knowledge. You’re an organized self-starter, an excellent communicator who is highly analytical and has a track record for improving the processes and organizations around you.

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of sales or prospecting experience at a technology company and a track record of top performance
  • Owning a direct sales quota, with direct sales experience closing new business and/or expansion of existing users
  • A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners
  • A proven ability to be a self-starter capable of driving business results without significant supervision
  • An enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves” mentality
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong presentation skills, particularly for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders
  • Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements
  • Ability to understand complex technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple stakeholders

Preferred qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience specifically selling financial services or similar software 
  • Experience in selling Tax solutions
  • Proven ability to sell complex software solutions

In-office Expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp partners with football clubs to introduce relevant businesses to Ramp and create measurable commercial value for both organisations.

As the UK Football Channel Partner Manager, you will nurture and grow Ramp’s existing UK football-club partnerships. You will work with each club to activate the partnership assets we have agreed—including business-community activations, hospitality, warm introductions, campaigns, and follow-up—and ensure each partnership generates qualified sales opportunities for Ramp.

You will work closely with club commercial and partnership teams, alongside Ramp’s Sales, Marketing, Events, Product, and Engineering teams. Championship partnerships will focus on building repeatable, club-sourced pipeline from UK small and medium-sized businesses. Premier League partnerships will focus on senior executive relationships, curated hospitality, strategic introductions, and enterprise pipeline influence.

This is a highly cross-functional, hands-on role for someone who combines strong partner management with excellent commercial judgement and execution.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the activation and commercial performance of Ramp’s current UK football-club partnerships.

  • Build intentional, club-specific commercial plans using agreed partnership assets. Plans may include target-account lists, events, campaigns, warm-introduction routes, and clear success measures.

  • Partner with club commercial teams to identify and engage relevant local businesses, corporate partners, suppliers, business-club members, owners, and finance leaders.

  • Plan and deliver matchday hospitality, executive dinners, business-networking events, and other activations that create high-quality meetings and introductions for Ramp.

  • Lead club-led outreach and campaigns, ensuring audiences are relevant, appropriately permissioned, and measurable.

  • Coordinate introductions and follow-up with Ramp’s Sales team so club activity becomes meaningful sales opportunities.

  • Track performance from club activity through qualified lead, accepted meeting, application, and activated customer.

  • Run regular partner operating reviews and quarterly business reviews; use results to improve activation plans and hold teams accountable to agreed commitments.

  • Coordinate internal teams across Marketing, Growth, Sales, Events, Product, and Engineering to support club activations and customer onboarding.

  • Build a deep understanding of Ramp’s products, customer value, and workflows so you can represent Ramp credibly with club partners and prospects.

  • 5+ years of experience, including 3+ years in partnerships, business development, partner sales, account management, or commercial strategy.

  • A track record of building trusted senior relationships and delivering measurable commercial results through partners.

  • Strong event, hospitality, campaign, and go-to-market execution skills.

  • Excellent judgement when identifying high-quality prospects, shaping warm introductions, and coordinating multiple stakeholders.

  • Comfort using performance data to improve plans, report results, and manage to goals.

  • Excellent written, verbal, and listening skills.

  • A highly collaborative working style and the ability to work effectively across teams.

LayerZero

The Future is Omnichain.

Founded in 2021, LayerZero’s vision is to create a community of cross-chain developers, building dApps that are no longer constrained by individual blockchain capabilities. With LayerZero's simple, generic messaging protocol, builders will develop cross-chain dApps designed to unify the power of individual blockchains.

We are funded by the best investors in the world including:

a16z, Sequoia, PayPal, Binance Ventures, Coinbase Ventures, Uniswap Labs, Circle Ventures, Delphi Digital, and many more.

ABOUT THE ROLE

At LayerZero, our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team is at the intersection of software and systems engineering, dedicated to crafting and maintaining large-scale, resilient systems. Our goal is to ensure that all LayerZero services — ranging from critical internal systems to those external users interact with — are reliable, meet the uptime expectations of our users, and continuously evolve at a swift pace. Our SRE professionals will monitor our system's capacity and performance to uphold these standards. 

As Manager of SRE, you'll lead a team of engineers responsible for the reliability, performance, and scalability of our blockchain node infrastructure and platform services — while staying technically sharp enough to guide architecture decisions and jump into critical incidents. You'll balance people leadership with hands-on technical judgment, shaping how the team works, grows, and scales alongside LayerZero.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Lead and develop a team of SREs — setting technical direction, growth plans, and performance expectations.
  • Own the reliability strategy for blockchain node infrastructure across a variety of DLTs, including SLOs, capacity planning, and incident response.
  • Partner with Engineering leadership and Product/Platform teams to align reliability investments with business priorities.
  • Drive infrastructure-as-code practices, with a focus on Kubernetes and Helm at scale.
  • Establish and continuously improve on-call structure, incident detection/triage automation, and postmortem culture.
  • Stay hands-on: review designs, dig into complex incidents, and set the technical bar for the team.

ABOUT YOU

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, similar technical field of study, or equivalent practical experience.  
  • 6+ years in SRE, DevOps, or infrastructure engineering, including 2+ years directly managing or leading a technical team.
  • Deep familiarity with blockchain node infrastructure (validator/full/archive nodes, RPC optimization, etc.).
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript or Golang, with the judgment to know when to write code vs. delegate.
  • Advanced knowledge of Unix/Linux internals and distributed systems / high-availability design.

Safe Software is looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist, Go-To-Market to join our Human Resources team. In this role, you will own full-cycle recruitment for our revenue-facing organization: quota-carrying Sales and Sales Leadership, Marketing, Customer Success, Partnerships and Channel, Solutions and Sales Engineering, and Revenue Operations. You will build proactive pipelines in competitive GTM talent markets, act as a trusted advisor to revenue leaders, and elevate the candidate experience at every stage. While GTM hiring is your primary focus, you may also support hiring across other parts of the business as priorities shift.

Your work will directly influence Safe’s growth by bringing in resilient, high-performing commercial talent who thrive in our dynamic, customer-obsessed environment.

About The Team

As part of the Talent Acquisition team, you’ll join a collaborative group of recruiters and HR professionals who partner closely with hiring managers, business leaders, and the larger Human Resources team. In this role, you will work day-to-day with our GTM leadership, including Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partnerships, to deeply understand revenue targets, territory plans, and headcount needs, and translate them into hiring plans that land.

The Talent Acquisition team is responsible for sourcing top talent, managing the hiring process end-to-end, implementing assessment tools, and continuously improving our recruitment practices for scalability and global growth.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist, Go-To-Market, you will:

  • Own full-cycle recruitment for GTM roles, from intake to offer close, across Sales (AE, AM, SDR), Sales Leadership, Marketing, Customer Success, Partnerships and Channel, Solutions and Sales Engineering, and Revenue Operations.

  • Develop and execute proactive sourcing strategies for competitive commercial talent markets across Canada and the US, including passive outreach to top performers who aren’t actively looking.

  • Partner closely with revenue leaders to understand territory and quota plans, define role scorecards, refine job descriptions, and build hiring strategies that match the pace of the business.

  • Build and nurture evergreen talent pipelines and talent maps for repeatable GTM roles and for hard-to-fill specialist and leadership hires.

  • Leverage LinkedIn Recruiter, Ashby, our ATS system, job boards, social sourcing, referrals, industry events, and competitive market intelligence to identify high-quality commercial candidates.

  • Assess for GTM-specific signals, including quota attainment and consistency, deal size and sales cycle complexity, territory and segment fit, technical aptitude for selling a technical product, and customer-facing communication skills.

  • Conduct thorough candidate assessments using structured and behaviour-based interviews, and introduce role-specific evaluation mechanisms such as mock discovery calls, pitch or demo exercises, written work samples, marketing portfolio reviews, and case-based challenges.

  • Act as a market expert to hiring managers, advising on compensation expectations for commission-based roles, competitor talent movement, time-to-hire realities, and where the talent actually is.

  • Sell the Safe story, including our product, customers, culture, and long-term stability, to candidates who have multiple competing offers.

  • Communicate regularly with candidates, providing updates and feedback while maintaining Safe’s human-centred approach.

  • Analyze recruitment data and metrics, including pipeline conversion, source effectiveness, time-to-fill, offer acceptance, and quality of hire, to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

Qualifications, Skills, and Competencies

Safers come from a variety of backgrounds with a diversity in skills and knowledge. That said, we find that those who are most successful in this role have experience with the following areas.

Required Skills

descriptions.job-08r51gc:
The Team

The People Team at Chainalysis is dedicated to enabling growth, building an inclusive environment, and providing the support that helps our employees do the best work of their careers. Chainalysis is at a defining moment, transforming from a product-based company to an intelligence platform AI native company. The People Team plays a critical role in ensuring our organization evolves as fast as our technology.

Our Go-To-Market organization, spanning Sales, Sales Engineering (Solution Architects), Customer Success, Partnerships, and Revenue Operations, is the engine driving that momentum. As we scale, our GTM teams need an HR Business Partner who operates with the same speed, intensity, and bias for action that defines the business itself.

The Role

As Director, HR Business Partner, Go-To-Market, you will be the strategic people partner embedded directly within our GTM leadership team. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role at the Director level. You will not manage a team, but you will be expected to operate with the authority, judgment, and executive presence of a senior leader. You will own the full scope of people strategy for GTM end-to-end: from organizational design and talent planning to performance management, employee relations, and change management. You are the single point of accountability for translating business priorities into people initiatives that accelerate revenue growth.

A trusted, high-impact partnership with the COO will be critical to success in this role, one in which the HR Business Partner’s voice is heard, ideas are valued, and creative thinking shapes consequential people and business decisions. You are essential to GTM success. With a significant body of work ahead, this is not a role for the faint of heart; it requires the imagination, resourcefulness, resilience, and influence to turn ambitious priorities into meaningful results.

Their role demands an execution-oriented leader, someone who doesn't wait for direction, moves fast, takes risks, is willing to make mistakes, drives outcomes with urgency, and brings a relentless focus on getting things done. You thrive in high-growth, high-change environments and are energized by the pace and complexity of a scaling GTM organization. You are equally comfortable coaching a CRO or COO through a sensitive org restructure as you are rolling up your sleeves to build a new compensation framework or run a talent calibration session from scratch. Your opinion matters, have one.

In this role, you'll:

Drive GTM People Strategy with Speed and Precision

  • Own and execute the end-to-end people strategy for the Go-To-Market organization, directly partnering with the COO, CRO, and CCO to align talent priorities with revenue targets.

  • Lead organizational design efforts to ensure the GTM structure scales efficiently, proactively identifying gaps, redundancies, and opportunities to optimize team composition as the business evolves.

  • Develop and execute workforce planning strategies that anticipate hiring needs, succession gaps, and capability builds across Sales, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Partnerships, and Revenue Operations.

  • Operate as a true business partner, not a support function. Bring data, recommendations, and a point of view to every leadership conversation, and hold leaders accountable to people's commitments.

Own Talent Management and Performance Execution

  • Drive and build a rigorous, outcomes-based performance management culture across GTM, ensuring that high performers are recognized and rewarded, and that underperformance is addressed swiftly and directly.

  • Lead talent review and calibration processes for GTM, partnering with leaders to build robust succession plans for critical revenue-facing roles.

  • Design and implement GTM-specific retention strategies, with a focus on high-impact sellers, technical sales talent, and customer-facing leaders in competitive talent markets.

  • Coach and advise GTM managers at all levels on leadership development, team effectiveness, and building high-performing sales and customer success cultures.

Execute on Compensation, Incentives, and GTM-Specific Programs

  • Partner with Revenue Operations and Total Rewards to design and refine GTM compensation structures, including variable pay, sales incentive plans, SPIFs, and quota-setting frameworks that drive the right behaviors and outcomes.

  • Analyze compensation competitiveness within the sales and GTM talent market, making proactive recommendations to attract and retain top revenue talent.

  • Lead GTM-specific people programs including onboarding for revenue hires, ramp-time optimization, sales enablement alignment, and GTM-wide engagement initiatives, with a bias toward measurable impact.

Lead Change Management and Employee Relations with Conviction

  • Drive change management initiatives across GTM with urgency and clarity: territory realignments, org restructures, RIF planning, and M&A integration for acquired sales and customer teams.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all employee relations matters within GTM, handling complex and sensitive situations with sound judgment, speed, and discretion.

  • Navigate ambiguity with confidence. In a fast-moving GTM environment, you make decisions with imperfect information, course-correct quickly, and never let process slow down progress.

  • Ensure compliance with employment laws and company policies while maintaining a pragmatic, business-first approach to risk.

Build Deep Partnerships Across the Business

  • Forge strong, trust-based relationships with the COO, CRO, CCO, and broader GTM executives. Become the go-to advisor on all things people, from strategic org decisions to day-to-day people challenges.

  • Collaborate closely with Talent Acquisition to drive aggressive hiring plans, ensuring the right talent pipeline for quota-carrying and customer-facing roles.

  • Partner with People Operations, Total Rewards, L&D, and HRIS teams to ensure GTM-specific needs are reflected in company-wide programs and systems.

  • Bring a "one team" mindset. While your focus is GTM, you operate as part of the broader People team and contribute to enterprise-wide HR initiatives and best practices.

We're looking for candidates who have:

  • 10+ years of progressive HR Business Partner experience, with at least 5 years supporting Go-To-Market, Sales, or Revenue organizations in high-growth B2B SaaS or technology companies.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a Director-level individual contributor. You bring executive-level strategic thinking and hands-on execution in equal measure without needing a team behind you.

  • A track record of thriving in fast-paced, high-growth, and ambiguous environments. You've built and iterated on people strategies while the business was scaling rapidly around you.

  • Deep expertise in GTM talent dynamics: sales compensation design, quota-based performance management, territory planning, and retention strategies for revenue-critical roles.

  • Proven ability to influence and advise senior leaders (VP and C-level) with data-driven recommendations and a willingness to challenge the status quo.

  • Strong employee relations experience with a demonstrated ability to handle complex, high-stakes situations with speed, good judgment, and confidentiality.

  • Exceptional communication skills. You are direct, clear, and persuasive, whether you're coaching a first-time manager or presenting an org design proposal to the executive team.

  • An aggressive, action-oriented disposition. You are known for driving results, holding a high bar, and refusing to let inertia or ambiguity slow you down.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in blockchain, fintech, cybersecurity, or regulated technology industries.

  • Familiarity with HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday), people analytics tools, and modern HR tech stacks.

  • Experience supporting globally distributed GTM teams across multiple regions and time zones.

  • HR certification (PHR, SPHR, SHRM-CP, or SHRM-SCP)

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Platform Sales team works with B2B Software Platforms to help them facilitate payments for their customers using our Stripe Connect product. Software Platforms, also known as B2B Indirect, are software platform businesses who serve other businesses. Platforms already using Stripe include Planity, TheFork, Prestashop and Shopify. As a key member to the Stripe Platforms team, you will manage and elevate relationships with a named account list while identifying new growth opportunities and ways Stripe can exceed expectations. 

If you’re motivated, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you!

What you’ll do

As an Account Executive (Grower), you will create partnerships between Stripe and the most innovative and fastest-growing software platforms in the world by helping them to understand how Stripe’s online commerce infrastructure can make payments a competitive advantage for their businesses.

Responsibilities

  • Directly manage and nurture a named account list and develop account plans for winning and expanding business with upper middle market and enterprise SaaS Platform companies
  • Build and maintain key relationships with C-level executives, while orchestrating the right executive touch points as well
  • Own the full sales cycle from lead to close for upper middle market and enterprise companies
  • Work with company leaders from multiple functions (e.g., Engineering, Product, and Finance) to lead complex product workshops and financial analyse
  • Craft and lead complex, bespoke commercial & contractual negotiations
  • Contribute to shaping our platform partnership strategy and building repeatable processes and scaled engagement models
  • Lead and contribute to team projects to develop and refine our sales process
  • Engage with Product and Engineering teams to help drive product strategy

Who you are

You are an adept salesperson and relationship manager capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization, including the CTO, COO, and CFO. You have experience working with upper middle market and enterprise companies. You have an in-depth understanding of the buyer journey and can lead a complex, multi-party sale in a highly consultative manner. You are used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require deep product understanding, combined with technical knowledge. You are naturally analytical and enjoy digging into business models and helping customers quantify their investment decisions. You get excited about prospecting, and are capable of independently leading a sales cycle from start to finish. Finally, you enjoy building – you like to actively participate in the development of our sales process, the articulation of our value proposition, and the creation of key tools and assets.

Minimum requirements

  • 7+ years of sales experience, preferably selling a technical product, with a track record of top performance
  • Extensive experience directly selling a technology product or service, preferably at an API-first company, with a record of top performance
  • A proven track record of moving sales processes forward from inception to close by leading complex, multi-party sales in a highly consultative manner, understanding strategies and applying value proposition
  • Great listening skills and ability to quickly become a trusted resource for decision-makers across technology and finance orgs within software companies
  • An ability to understand complex technical problems and understand how Stripe’s solutions can address them
  • A positive attitude and tireless work ethic when encountering blockers to success, whether external or internal
  • Strong presentation skills
  • Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills in French and English
  • Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment
  • Strong interest in technology and a deep understanding of the space
  • Experience in or excitement in learning about financial technology infrastructure
  • Fastidious approach to CRM hygiene and experience utilizing thorough sales forecasting metrics on a weekly/quarterly basis and communicating them in a succinct manner
descriptions.job-0iip5wc:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.
Role Overview
We are looking for a highly driven and data-oriented Growth Operations Lead to join Bybit’s Earn & Wealth business.
 
This role will act as a core driver of business growth, responsible for scaling user acquisition, engagement, and asset conversion (AUM growth) across key products such as Savings, Staking, Dual Investment, and Launchpool.
 
You will combine market insights, user behavior analysis, and data-driven execution to build scalable growth systems and continuously optimize business performance.
 
Key Responsibilities
1. Growth Strategy & Execution
  • Define and execute user growth, conversion, and retention strategies across the Earn & Wealth product suite
  • Build and optimize the full user lifecycle framework (onboarding → first investment → repeat investment → high-value user upgrade)
  • Lead end-to-end planning, execution, and ROI evaluation of growth campaigns and initiatives
2. User Segmentation & Lifecycle Management
  • Develop user segmentation models based on AUM, risk appetite, behavior, and engagement patterns
  • Design targeted strategies and journeys for different user cohorts
  • Drive precision marketing through CRM, push notifications, email, and other engagement channels
3. Data Analytics & Optimization
  • Build and maintain dashboards to track key business metrics (AUM, ARPU, conversion rates, retention, etc.)
  • Leverage A/B testing and data insights to continuously optimize user journeys and product experience
  • Generate structured insights and performance reports to support product and business decision-making
4. Cross-functional Collaboration
  • Partner closely with Product, Finance, and BD teams to enhance product capabilities and monetization
  • Collaborate with Content, KOL, and Paid Media teams to amplify growth impact
  • Contribute to GTM (Go-To-Market) strategies for new product launches, ensuring operational excellence across the lifecycle

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

  • Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.

  • Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

Role Roadmap

Kalshi is looking for a Senior Accountant to join our growing Finance team. This is a highly hands-on role for someone who wants to own meaningful parts of the accounting close, improve processes, and help build the financial infrastructure of a rapidly scaling company.

You’ll work across the business to ensure transactions are recorded accurately, accounts are reconciled, and our financials are complete and audit-ready. As Kalshi continues to scale, you’ll also help strengthen controls, automate workflows, and build processes that can support increasing complexity and future public-company requirements.

What You’ll Do

  • Own key areas of the monthly, quarterly, and annual close process

  • Ensure transactions are recorded accurately and in accordance with U.S. GAAP

  • Support preparation of monthly financial statements and management reporting

  • Help build the accounting infrastructure required as Kalshi continues to scale

What You Bring

  • Experience owning significant components of the monthly close

  • Strong experience with journal entries, account reconciliations, and financial statement preparation

  • Comfortable working cross-functionally and translating business activity into accurate accounting treatment

  • Experience supporting audits, implementing controls, or preparing a company for increased reporting requirements is a plus

Salary Range: $120,000 to $175,000 annually plus equity and benefits.
This range reflects current market data for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and broad variance in experience levels within each title; if your compensation expectations exceed this range, we encourage you to reach out - we’re always happy to discuss.

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.

Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.

  • Collaborate closely with the product, partnerships, engineering, marketing, and customer success teams to ensure client satisfaction and long-term growth.
